name: Ricochet Robots Planning
description: Neural planners for Ricochet Robots on Karolina (repo MCTS_evolution): per-size supervised backward/forward planners, a size-free NN labeler, and an AlphaZero-style certified self-play program (base and extended-B2 subgoal vocabularies, mixed-size curriculum, forward-move loop, structural variants lab). Metric: realized playable moves at equal search budget (1200 expansions, k=5, replay-certified).
